verdict.rationale: Steel is a stealth and CAPTCHA-solving browser automation vendor, so a published acceptable-use or anti-abuse policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents stealth, proxy and CAPTCHA-solving features but contains no acceptable-use policy, terms of service, or anti-abuse statement governing how those features may be used.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can point to the vendor's published acceptable-use and anti-abuse posture governing what its stealth and automation features may be used for
